statements.statement: The claim was denied under reason code CO-197
The denial was because required prior authorization was not obtained
The patient has recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered
The monitoring was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances and guide subsequent management
Diagnosis codes R55 and I48.91 were submitted
